{"markdown": "- Adults aged 18 years or older at the time of informed consent (per NCT03743766, NCT04091750, NCT04464759, NCT04401995, NCT05561491, NCT06190951).
- Histologically or cytologically confirmed unresectable or metastatic melanoma (per design brief population).
- Documented disease progression on prior anti-PD-1 therapy (per design brief population).
- Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 (per NCT04091750, NCT04464759, NCT04401995, NCT05561491, NCT06190951).
- Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 criteria [TBD: specify version if different].
- Adequate organ function as defined by laboratory parameters [TBD: specify thresholds for hematologic, hepatic, and renal function].
- Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks [TBD: confirm if applicable].
- Willing and able to comply with study procedures and provide written informed consent.
- For women of childbearing potential and men with partners of childbearing potential: agreement to use highly effective contraception during treatment and for a specified period after the last dose [TBD: specify duration].
- No prior treatment with Drug X or any other agent targeting the same pathway [TBD: specify if needed].
- No active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppression [TBD: specify exclusions if needed].
- No known active central nervous system metastases unless treated and stable [TBD: specify criteria for stability].
- No concurrent malignancy requiring active treatment [TBD: specify exceptions if needed]."}
